## Purpose

Describe the archival, editorial, retrieval, access, or infrastructure outcome.

- Source or decision IDs:

## Changes

- [ ] Schema or migration
- [ ] Archive policy or documentation
- [ ] Ingestion or preservation tooling
- [ ] RAG, graph, or evaluation
- [ ] Vercel access experience

## Quality gates

- [ ] Migrations replay in the Supabase preview branch
- [ ] RLS, grants, indexes, and advisors reviewed
- [ ] Stable IDs and provenance preserved
- [ ] Rights, consent, privacy, and sensitivity reviewed
- [ ] Fixity and package validation completed where files changed
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm run validate`, `npm test`, `npm run test:edge`, and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Protected Vercel preview verified
- [ ] No credential values or private signed URLs are present

## Release decision

State whether this is internal-only, reading-room, or public, and identify the approving owner. Production promotion and public access require an explicit approval record.
